design:
Source-choice diagnostic: marginal per-minute rates need not be lineup odds.

Fits no simulated box residual, shooting outcome, on/off or OVR target. The base
season-rate inputs already use all games; the game split is a conditional-choice
check, not a blind or prospective player evaluation. Not an adopted model.
regularizer: Poisson log-odds prior: lambda*(exp(delta)-delta-1), centered at original minute-smoothed rates. Lambda is league rate times original60min shot or240min DREB prior. Fixed before fitting; no ranking selection. Actual choices condition on the five eligible players; DREB remains conditional allocation only, no team rebound probability change.
